meta.coordinate_system: Planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude in degrees on Mars. Geographic bounds are outer pixel edges. Each route vertex is a MOLA cell center.
meta.geometry_model: Local equirectangular distances on a 3396000 m sphere (MOLA label radius), standard parallel at the crop midpoint. Regional approximation.

sources.name: MGS / MOLA topography
sources.label: https://pds-geosciences.wustl.edu/mgs/urn-nasa-pds-mgs_mola_topography_derived/meg128/megt44n000hb.lbl
sources.credit: NASA GSFC / MGS MOLA Science Team, PDS Geosciences Node
sources.processing: MEGT44N000HB v2.0. Native 1/128 degree median elevation, integer meters above the GMM3 areoid. Exact grid crop, no resampling. PDS fills unsounded bins by interpolation.

sources.name: MGS / MOLA shot counts
sources.label: https://pds-geosciences.wustl.edu/mgs/urn-nasa-pds-mgs_mola_topography_derived/meg128/megc44n000hb.lbl
sources.credit: NASA GSFC / MGS MOLA Science Team, PDS Geosciences Node
sources.processing: MEGC44N000HB v2.0. Co-registered native crop. Zero observations indicates a product-interpolated elevation. Counts are neither confidence intervals nor hazard measurements.

sources.name: MRO / CTX orbital mosaic
sources.label: https://doi.org/10.5066/P906QQT8
sources.processing: Mars 2020 TRN CTX 6 m orthoimage. Cropped in source EQC meters, area-averaged to 1344 by 784, valid pixels stretched at 1st and 99th percentiles. Zero source DN is nodata, masked output is transparent.

sources.name: Mars 2020 / Perseverance waypoints
sources.label: https://science.nasa.gov/mission/mars-2020-perseverance/location-map/
sources.credit: NASA / JPL-Caltech, Mars 2020 mission mapping team
sources.processing: Three end-of-drive point records selected by sol and RMC. Coordinates retained as published. Suggested walk connects snapped grid centers independently of rover history.

assumptions: Exploratory grid model. Each cell is roughly 440 by 463 meters. Sub-cell hazards are unresolved.
Local cell grade or directional edge grade above 18% excludes travel. Diagonals cannot cross blocked corners. This threshold is a scenario assumption.
Effort is horizontal distance in km times (1 + 6 × mean local grade), plus 10 × positive climb in km.
Penalty per km blends normalized grade, zero-shot MOLA bins and proximity to excluded cells. Total score = effort + 4 × integrated penalty. Scores are dimensionless planning indices.
No physiological, radiation-dose, weather, oxygen or walking-time model. The recommended path is hypothetical.
meta.ai_disclosure: Codex-assisted processing and routing code. Elevations, shot counts, imagery and waypoints are mission products.
